---- MODULE W4Od19m2p0t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Books, Patrons, Branches

VARIABLES
  txn,     \* the <<book, patron>> reservation under two-phase commit, or "none"
  vote,    \* [Branches -> {"none","yes","no"}] prepare votes (recorded in any order)
  active,  \* set of <<book, patron>> reservations currently held
  history  \* set of <<book, patron>> reservations that have been returned

vars == <<txn, vote, active, history>>

NoTxn == "none"
BookOf(x)   == x[1]
PatronOf(x) == x[2]
BookHeld(b) == \E x \in active : BookOf(x) = b

TypeOK ==
  /\ txn \in (Books \X Patrons) \cup {NoTxn}
  /\ vote \in [Branches -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
  /\ active \subseteq (Books \X Patrons)
  /\ history \subseteq (Books \X Patrons)

Init ==
  /\ txn = NoTxn
  /\ vote = [br \in Branches |-> "none"]
  /\ active = {}
  /\ history = {}

\* Open a two-phase commit to reserve a currently-unheld book for a patron
Propose(b, p) ==
  /\ txn = NoTxn
  /\ ~BookHeld(b)
  /\ txn' = <<b, p>>
  /\ vote' = [br \in Branches |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<active, history>>

\* A branch casts a prepare vote; reordering means votes are recorded in any order
CastVote(br, v) ==
  /\ txn # NoTxn
  /\ vote[br] = "none"
  /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![br] = v]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<txn, active, history>>

\* Commit the reservation once every branch voted yes and the book is still unheld
Commit ==
  /\ txn # NoTxn
  /\ \A br \in Branches : vote[br] = "yes"
  /\ ~BookHeld(BookOf(txn))
  /\ active' = active \cup {txn}
  /\ txn' = NoTxn
  /\ vote' = [br \in Branches |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED history

\* Abort the reservation if any branch voted no
Abort ==
  /\ txn # NoTxn
  /\ \E br \in Branches : vote[br] = "no"
  /\ txn' = NoTxn
  /\ vote' = [br \in Branches |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<active, history>>

\* A patron returns a reserved book, freeing it
Return(b, p) ==
  /\ <<b, p>> \in active
  /\ active' = active \ {<<b, p>>}
  /\ history' = history \cup {<<b, p>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<txn, vote>>

Next ==
  \/ \E b \in Books, p \in Patrons : Propose(b, p)
  \/ \E br \in Branches, v \in {"yes", "no"} : CastVote(br, v)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Abort
  \/ \E b \in Books, p \in Patrons : Return(b, p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A book is reserved by at most one patron at a time: reservations are exclusive
Mutex ==
  \A x, y \in active : (BookOf(x) = BookOf(y)) => (PatronOf(x) = PatronOf(y))
====
nl: A library book reservation system grants exclusive reservations on book copies via two-phase commit across branches. The coordinator opens a transaction to reserve a currently-unheld book for a patron, resetting the prepare votes. Each branch casts a single yes or no prepare vote, and because messages can be reordered, votes may be recorded in any order. The reservation commits only when every branch has voted yes and the book is still unheld, adding it to the active reservations; it aborts if any branch voted no. A patron returns a reserved book, freeing it for others. SAFETY PROPERTY: a book is reserved by at most one patron at a time, so no book is ever held by two different patrons at once.

---- MODULE W4Od1m5p0t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Runways, Aircraft, Controllers

VARIABLES
  lock,        \* [Runways -> Aircraft \cup {"free"}] exclusive holder of each runway
  using,       \* [Aircraft -> Runways \cup {"none"}] runway an aircraft is currently on
  approvals,   \* set of <<runway, aircraft, controller>> quorum approvals
  adminGrant   \* set of aircraft with a privileged admin override

vars == <<lock, using, approvals, adminGrant>>

Free   == "free"
NoR    == "none"
Quorum == 2
ApprovalsFor(rw, a) == { c \in Controllers : <<rw, a, c>> \in approvals }

TypeOK ==
  /\ lock \in [Runways -> Aircraft \cup {Free}]
  /\ using \in [Aircraft -> Runways \cup {NoR}]
  /\ approvals \subseteq (Runways \X Aircraft \X Controllers)
  /\ adminGrant \subseteq Aircraft

Init ==
  /\ lock = [rw \in Runways |-> Free]
  /\ using = [a \in Aircraft |-> NoR]
  /\ approvals = {}
  /\ adminGrant = {}

\* A controller approves an aircraft taking a runway
Approve(rw, a, c) ==
  /\ <<rw, a, c>> \notin approvals
  /\ approvals' = approvals \cup {<<rw, a, c>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, using, adminGrant>>

\* Enter a free runway once a quorum approves, or under an admin override
Enter(rw, a) ==
  /\ lock[rw] = Free
  /\ using[a] = NoR
  /\ (Cardinality(ApprovalsFor(rw, a)) >= Quorum \/ a \in adminGrant)
  /\ lock' = [lock EXCEPT ![rw] = a]
  /\ using' = [using EXCEPT ![a] = rw]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<approvals, adminGrant>>

\* An aircraft clears the runway it holds
Leave(rw, a) ==
  /\ lock[rw] = a
  /\ using[a] = rw
  /\ lock' = [lock EXCEPT ![rw] = Free]
  /\ using' = [using EXCEPT ![a] = NoR]
  /\ approvals' = { x \in approvals : ~(x[1] = rw /\ x[2] = a) }
  /\ UNCHANGED adminGrant

\* The tower grants a privileged admin override to an aircraft
GrantOverride(a) ==
  /\ a \notin adminGrant
  /\ adminGrant' = adminGrant \cup {a}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, using, approvals>>

\* The tower revokes an override from an aircraft not currently on a runway
RevokeOverride(a) ==
  /\ a \in adminGrant
  /\ using[a] = NoR
  /\ adminGrant' = adminGrant \ {a}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, using, approvals>>

Next ==
  \/ \E rw \in Runways, a \in Aircraft, c \in Controllers : Approve(rw, a, c)
  \/ \E rw \in Runways, a \in Aircraft : Enter(rw, a)
  \/ \E rw \in Runways, a \in Aircraft : Leave(rw, a)
  \/ \E a \in Aircraft : GrantOverride(a)
  \/ \E a \in Aircraft : RevokeOverride(a)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* An aircraft occupies a runway only while it exclusively holds that runway's lock
Mutex ==
  \A a \in Aircraft : using[a] # NoR => lock[using[a]] = a
====
nl: An air-traffic runway allocator grants exclusive runway occupancy, approved by quorum voting among controllers, with a privileged admin override. A controller approves an aircraft taking a runway. An aircraft enters a free runway once a quorum of controllers has approved, or under an admin override granted by the tower, taking exclusive hold of that runway's lock. An aircraft clears the runway it holds, discarding the approvals for that pairing. The tower may grant a privileged admin override to an aircraft and may revoke an override from an aircraft not currently on a runway. SAFETY PROPERTY: an aircraft occupies a runway only while it exclusively holds that runway's lock, so no two aircraft ever share a runway.

---- MODULE W4Od2m2p0t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Zones, Robots, Voters

VARIABLES
  lock,        \* [Zones -> Robots \cup {"free"}] exclusive holder of each zone
  inZone,      \* [Robots -> Zones \cup {"none"}] zone a robot is currently in
  txn,         \* the <<zone, robot>> grant under two-phase commit, or "none"
  approvals,   \* set of voters who approved the current transaction
  adminGrant   \* set of robots with a privileged admin override

vars == <<lock, inZone, txn, approvals, adminGrant>>

Free  == "free"
NoZ   == "none"
NoTxn == "none"

TypeOK ==
  /\ lock \in [Zones -> Robots \cup {Free}]
  /\ inZone \in [Robots -> Zones \cup {NoZ}]
  /\ txn \in (Zones \X Robots) \cup {NoTxn}
  /\ approvals \subseteq Voters
  /\ adminGrant \subseteq Robots

Init ==
  /\ lock = [z \in Zones |-> Free]
  /\ inZone = [r \in Robots |-> NoZ]
  /\ txn = NoTxn
  /\ approvals = {}
  /\ adminGrant = {}

\* Open a two-phase commit granting a free zone to an idle robot
Propose(z, r) ==
  /\ txn = NoTxn
  /\ lock[z] = Free
  /\ inZone[r] = NoZ
  /\ txn' = <<z, r>>
  /\ approvals' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, inZone, adminGrant>>

\* A voter approves the current transaction
Approve(v) ==
  /\ txn # NoTxn
  /\ v \notin approvals
  /\ approvals' = approvals \cup {v}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, inZone, txn, adminGrant>>

\* Commit when all voters approved, or immediately under the robot's admin override
Commit ==
  /\ txn # NoTxn
  /\ (approvals = Voters \/ txn[2] \in adminGrant)
  /\ lock[txn[1]] = Free
  /\ lock' = [lock EXCEPT ![txn[1]] = txn[2]]
  /\ inZone' = [inZone EXCEPT ![txn[2]] = txn[1]]
  /\ txn' = NoTxn
  /\ approvals' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED adminGrant

\* Abort the current transaction
Abort ==
  /\ txn # NoTxn
  /\ txn' = NoTxn
  /\ approvals' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, inZone, adminGrant>>

\* A robot leaves its zone, releasing the exclusive lock
Release(z, r) ==
  /\ lock[z] = r
  /\ inZone[r] = z
  /\ lock' = [lock EXCEPT ![z] = Free]
  /\ inZone' = [inZone EXCEPT ![r] = NoZ]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<txn, approvals, adminGrant>>

\* The supervisor grants a privileged admin override to a robot
GrantOverride(r) ==
  /\ r \notin adminGrant
  /\ adminGrant' = adminGrant \cup {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, inZone, txn, approvals>>

Next ==
  \/ \E z \in Zones, r \in Robots : Propose(z, r)
  \/ \E v \in Voters : Approve(v)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Abort
  \/ \E z \in Zones, r \in Robots : Release(z, r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : GrantOverride(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A robot occupies a zone only while it exclusively holds that zone's lock
Mutex ==
  \A r \in Robots : inZone[r] # NoZ => lock[inZone[r]] = r
====
nl: A warehouse robot fleet grants exclusive zone occupancy via two-phase commit across voters, with a privileged admin override. The coordinator opens a transaction granting a free zone to an idle robot, resetting approvals. A voter approves the current transaction. The grant commits when all voters have approved, or immediately under the robot's admin override, giving the robot exclusive hold of the zone's lock; it may otherwise be aborted. A robot leaves its zone, releasing the exclusive lock. The supervisor may grant a privileged admin override to a robot. SAFETY PROPERTY: a robot occupies a zone only while it exclusively holds that zone's lock, so no two robots ever share a zone.

---- MODULE W4Od0m3p0t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Nodes, Rooms, Surgeons

VARIABLES
  leader,   \* the node currently elected coordinator, or "none"
  term,     \* leadership term (advances on election)
  lock,     \* [Rooms -> Surgeons \cup {"free"}] exclusive holder of each room
  inRoom,   \* [Surgeons -> Rooms \cup {"none"}] room a surgeon currently occupies
  requests  \* set of <<room, surgeon>> access requests (may arrive reordered)

vars == <<leader, term, lock, inRoom, requests>>

None    == "none"
Free    == "free"
NoR     == "none"
MaxTerm == 2

TypeOK ==
  /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {None}
  /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
  /\ lock \in [Rooms -> Surgeons \cup {Free}]
  /\ inRoom \in [Surgeons -> Rooms \cup {NoR}]
  /\ requests \subseteq (Rooms \X Surgeons)

Init ==
  /\ leader = None
  /\ term = 0
  /\ lock = [rm \in Rooms |-> Free]
  /\ inRoom = [s \in Surgeons |-> NoR]
  /\ requests = {}

\* A coordinator is elected; the leaderless system can always elect
Elect(n) ==
  /\ leader = None
  /\ leader' = n
  /\ term' = IF term < MaxTerm THEN term + 1 ELSE MaxTerm
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, inRoom, requests>>

\* The coordinator crashes and steps down
StepDown ==
  /\ leader # None
  /\ leader' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, lock, inRoom, requests>>

\* An access request is submitted; requests may arrive in any order
Request(rm, s) ==
  /\ <<rm, s>> \notin requests
  /\ requests' = requests \cup {<<rm, s>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, lock, inRoom>>

\* Only the current coordinator may grant exclusive access to a free room
Grant(rm, s) ==
  /\ leader # None
  /\ <<rm, s>> \in requests
  /\ lock[rm] = Free
  /\ inRoom[s] = NoR
  /\ lock' = [lock EXCEPT ![rm] = s]
  /\ inRoom' = [inRoom EXCEPT ![s] = rm]
  /\ requests' = requests \ {<<rm, s>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term>>

\* A surgeon leaves the room, releasing the exclusive lock
Release(rm, s) ==
  /\ lock[rm] = s
  /\ inRoom[s] = rm
  /\ lock' = [lock EXCEPT ![rm] = Free]
  /\ inRoom' = [inRoom EXCEPT ![s] = NoR]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, requests>>

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
  \/ StepDown
  \/ \E rm \in Rooms, s \in Surgeons : Request(rm, s)
  \/ \E rm \in Rooms, s \in Surgeons : Grant(rm, s)
  \/ \E rm \in Rooms, s \in Surgeons : Release(rm, s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A surgeon occupies a room only while it exclusively holds that room's lock
Mutex ==
  \A s \in Surgeons : inRoom[s] # NoR => lock[inRoom[s]] = s
====
nl: A hospital operating-room scheduler grants exclusive room access under a coordinator elected among nodes by leader election with failover. A leaderless system can always elect a coordinator, advancing the leadership term, and the coordinator may crash and step down. Access requests are submitted and, because messages can be reordered, may arrive in any order. Only the current coordinator may grant exclusive access to a free room to a requesting surgeon, taking hold of that room's lock. A surgeon later leaves the room, releasing the exclusive lock. SAFETY PROPERTY: a surgeon occupies a room only while it exclusively holds that room's lock, so no two surgeons ever share a room.

---- MODULE W4Od17m4p5t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Bags, Routers

VARIABLES
  belt,      \* Seq of bags on the shared bounded conveyor belt
  routed,    \* Seq recording each irreversible final-chute routing in order
  diverted,  \* set of bags diverted off the belt without re-routing
  busy       \* [Routers -> Bags \cup {"idle"}] bag each router instance is handling

vars == <<belt, routed, diverted, busy>>

BeltCap  == 2
Idle     == "idle"
Range(s) == { s[i] : i \in 1..Len(s) }

TypeOK ==
  /\ belt \in Seq(Bags)
  /\ routed \in Seq(Bags)
  /\ diverted \subseteq Bags
  /\ busy \in [Routers -> Bags \cup {Idle}]

Init ==
  /\ belt = << >>
  /\ routed = << >>
  /\ diverted = {}
  /\ busy = [r \in Routers |-> Idle]

\* A bag mounts the shared bounded belt; a full belt applies backpressure
Load(b) ==
  /\ Len(belt) < BeltCap
  /\ b \notin Range(belt)
  /\ belt' = Append(belt, b)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<routed, diverted, busy>>

\* An idle router instance picks up the bag at the head of the shared belt
Pick(r, b) ==
  /\ busy[r] = Idle
  /\ Len(belt) > 0
  /\ Head(belt) = b
  /\ b \notin Range(routed)
  /\ busy' = [busy EXCEPT ![r] = b]
  /\ belt' = Tail(belt)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<routed, diverted>>

\* A router irreversibly commits the bag to its final chute, exactly once
Route(r, b) ==
  /\ busy[r] = b
  /\ b \notin Range(routed)
  /\ routed' = Append(routed, b)
  /\ busy' = [busy EXCEPT ![r] = Idle]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<belt, diverted>>

\* A bag already routed that reappears at the head is diverted instead of re-routing
Divert(b) ==
  /\ Len(belt) > 0
  /\ Head(belt) = b
  /\ b \in Range(routed)
  /\ belt' = Tail(belt)
  /\ diverted' = diverted \cup {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<routed, busy>>

Next ==
  \/ \E b \in Bags : Load(b)
  \/ \E r \in Routers, b \in Bags : Pick(r, b)
  \/ \E r \in Routers, b \in Bags : Route(r, b)
  \/ \E b \in Bags : Divert(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No bag is ever routed to a final chute more than once
RouteOnce ==
  Cardinality(Range(routed)) = Len(routed)
====
nl: An airport baggage router runs two independent router instances that share one bounded conveyor belt. A bag mounts the shared belt only while it has room and it is not already on the belt or already routed; a full belt applies backpressure. An idle router instance picks up the bag at the head of the shared belt. A router irreversibly commits the bag to its final chute exactly once, recording it in the routed log. A bag that was already routed and reappears at the head is diverted off the belt instead of being routed again. SAFETY PROPERTY: no bag is ever routed to a final chute more than once; the routed log never records the same bag twice.

---- MODULE W4Od0m1p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Nodes, Slots

VARIABLES
  token,    \* the node currently holding the ring token
  grants,   \* set of <<slot, node>> confirmed slot allocations
  pending,  \* set of <<slot, node>> allocation requests
  released  \* set of <<slot, node>> allocations that have been released

vars == <<token, grants, pending, released>>

NodeCount == 3
NextNode(n) == IF n = NodeCount - 1 THEN 0 ELSE n + 1
SlotOf(g) == g[1]
NodeOf(g) == g[2]
SlotTaken(s) == \E g \in grants : SlotOf(g) = s

TypeOK ==
  /\ token \in Nodes
  /\ grants \subseteq (Slots \X Nodes)
  /\ pending \subseteq (Slots \X Nodes)
  /\ released \subseteq (Slots \X Nodes)

Init ==
  /\ token = 0
  /\ grants = {}
  /\ pending = {}
  /\ released = {}

\* A node submits an allocation request for a slot
Request(s, n) ==
  /\ <<s, n>> \notin pending
  /\ <<s, n>> \notin grants
  /\ pending' = pending \cup {<<s, n>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, grants, released>>

\* Only the current token-holder may confirm one of its pending allocations
Allocate(s, n) ==
  /\ token = n
  /\ <<s, n>> \in pending
  /\ ~SlotTaken(s)
  /\ grants' = grants \cup {<<s, n>>}
  /\ pending' = pending \ {<<s, n>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, released>>

\* The token is passed to the next node in the ring; a slow node simply passes it on
PassToken ==
  /\ token' = NextNode(token)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, pending, released>>

\* A node releases one of its allocations, freeing the slot
Release(s, n) ==
  /\ <<s, n>> \in grants
  /\ grants' = grants \ {<<s, n>>}
  /\ released' = released \cup {<<s, n>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, pending>>

\* A released allocation is archived, allowing the slot to be requested again later
Archive(s, n) ==
  /\ <<s, n>> \in released
  /\ released' = released \ {<<s, n>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, grants, pending>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Slots, n \in Nodes : Request(s, n)
  \/ \E s \in Slots, n \in Nodes : Allocate(s, n)
  \/ PassToken
  \/ \E s \in Slots, n \in Nodes : Release(s, n)
  \/ \E s \in Slots, n \in Nodes : Archive(s, n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No slot is ever allocated to two different nodes at the same time
NoDoubleAlloc ==
  \A x, y \in grants : (SlotOf(x) = SlotOf(y)) => (NodeOf(x) = NodeOf(y))
====
nl: A hospital operating-room scheduler coordinates its scheduling nodes with a token ring: a single token circulates in a fixed ring order, and only the current token-holder may confirm an allocation. A node submits an allocation request for a slot. Only the current token-holder may confirm one of its pending allocations, and only for a slot that is not already taken. The token is passed to the next node in the ring, and a node that is slow but has not failed simply passes the token on without acting. A node releases one of its allocations, freeing the slot, and a released allocation is later archived so the slot can be requested again. SAFETY PROPERTY: no slot is ever allocated to two different nodes at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od13m7p5t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Selections, Customers

VARIABLES
  reg,      \* [Selections -> Customers \cup {"free"}] compare-and-swap claim register
  claimed,  \* [Customers -> Selections \cup {"none"}] selection a customer has claimed
  vendLog,  \* Seq recording each irreversible vend in order
  sold      \* set of <<selection, customer>> completed sales

vars == <<reg, claimed, vendLog, sold>>

Free     == "free"
NoS      == "none"
Range(s) == { s[i] : i \in 1..Len(s) }

TypeOK ==
  /\ reg \in [Selections -> Customers \cup {Free}]
  /\ claimed \in [Customers -> Selections \cup {NoS}]
  /\ vendLog \in Seq(Selections)
  /\ sold \subseteq (Selections \X Customers)

Init ==
  /\ reg = [s \in Selections |-> Free]
  /\ claimed = [c \in Customers |-> NoS]
  /\ vendLog = << >>
  /\ sold = {}

\* Compare-and-swap: a customer claims a selection by swapping its register from free
Claim(s, c) ==
  /\ reg[s] = Free
  /\ claimed[c] = NoS
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![s] = c]
  /\ claimed' = [claimed EXCEPT ![c] = s]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vendLog, sold>>

\* A (possibly slow) customer irreversibly vends its claimed selection, exactly once
Vend(s, c) ==
  /\ reg[s] = c
  /\ claimed[c] = s
  /\ s \notin Range(vendLog)
  /\ vendLog' = Append(vendLog, s)
  /\ sold' = sold \cup {<<s, c>>}
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![s] = Free]
  /\ claimed' = [claimed EXCEPT ![c] = NoS]

\* An already-vended selection's claim is released without vending again
Cancel(s, c) ==
  /\ reg[s] = c
  /\ claimed[c] = s
  /\ s \in Range(vendLog)
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![s] = Free]
  /\ claimed' = [claimed EXCEPT ![c] = NoS]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vendLog, sold>>

\* A completed sale is archived
Archive(s, c) ==
  /\ <<s, c>> \in sold
  /\ sold' = sold \ {<<s, c>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, claimed, vendLog>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Selections, c \in Customers : Claim(s, c)
  \/ \E s \in Selections, c \in Customers : Vend(s, c)
  \/ \E s \in Selections, c \in Customers : Cancel(s, c)
  \/ \E s \in Selections, c \in Customers : Archive(s, c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No selection is ever vended more than once: the vend log has no repeats
VendOnce ==
  Cardinality(Range(vendLog)) = Len(vendLog)
====
nl: A vending machine network guards each selection with a compare-and-swap claim register. A customer claims a selection by a compare-and-swap that succeeds when the selection's register is free, swapping it from free to that customer. A customer may be slow but does not fail; while holding its claim it irreversibly vends the claimed selection exactly once, recording the vend in the log, completing the sale, and releasing the register. An already-vended selection whose claim is held is released without vending again. A completed sale is later archived. SAFETY PROPERTY: no selection is ever vended more than once; the vend log never records the same selection twice.

---- MODULE W4Od13m1p4t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Instances

VARIABLES
  token,      \* the instance currently holding the ring token
  bin,        \* units currently held in the shared dispensing bin
  dispensed,  \* [Instances -> Nat] units each instance has dispensed to customers
  requests    \* number of outstanding restock requests

vars == <<token, bin, dispensed, requests>>

Cap     == 2
MaxDisp == 3
MaxReq  == 2
InstCount == 2
NextInst(i) == IF i = InstCount - 1 THEN 0 ELSE i + 1

TypeOK ==
  /\ token \in Instances
  /\ bin \in 0..Cap
  /\ dispensed \in [Instances -> 0..MaxDisp]
  /\ requests \in 0..MaxReq

Init ==
  /\ token = 0
  /\ bin = 0
  /\ dispensed = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
  /\ requests = 0

\* A restock request is registered
Request ==
  /\ requests < MaxReq
  /\ requests' = requests + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, bin, dispensed>>

\* Only the token-holder may fill the shared bin, and only while it is below capacity
Fill(i) ==
  /\ token = i
  /\ bin < Cap
  /\ requests > 0
  /\ bin' = bin + 1
  /\ requests' = requests - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, dispensed>>

\* Any instance dispenses one unit from the shared bin to a customer
Dispense(i) ==
  /\ bin > 0
  /\ dispensed[i] < MaxDisp
  /\ bin' = bin - 1
  /\ dispensed' = [dispensed EXCEPT ![i] = @ + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, requests>>

\* The token is passed to the next instance in the ring
PassToken ==
  /\ token' = NextInst(token)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bin, dispensed, requests>>

Next ==
  \/ Request
  \/ \E i \in Instances : Fill(i)
  \/ \E i \in Instances : Dispense(i)
  \/ PassToken

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The shared bin never holds more than its capacity of units
BoundedCapacity ==
  bin <= Cap
====

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
  Instances = {0, 1}
INVARIANT BoundedCapacity
nl: A vending machine network runs two independent instances that share one dispensing bin, coordinated by a token ring so that only one instance restocks at a time. A restock request is registered. Only the current token-holder may fill the shared bin, and only while the bin is below its capacity, consuming one restock request. Any instance may dispense one unit from the shared bin to a customer. The token is passed to the next instance in the ring. Because a fill is only permitted while the bin is below capacity, the bin never overflows. SAFETY PROPERTY: the shared dispensing bin never holds more than its capacity of units.

---- MODULE W4Od9m8p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Feeders, Controllers

VARIABLES
  unshed,     \* load units not yet shed, in the shared pool
  shedding,   \* load units currently being shed
  shed,       \* load units fully shed
  gridLock,   \* holder of the coarse grid lock, or "free"
  feederLock, \* [Feeders -> Controllers \cup {"free"}] fine per-feeder lock
  requests    \* set of <<controller, feeder>> shed requests (arrive reordered)

vars == <<unshed, shedding, shed, gridLock, feederLock, requests>>

Free  == "free"
Total == 3

TypeOK ==
  /\ unshed \in 0..Total
  /\ shedding \in 0..Total
  /\ shed \in 0..Total
  /\ gridLock \in Controllers \cup {Free}
  /\ feederLock \in [Feeders -> Controllers \cup {Free}]
  /\ requests \subseteq (Controllers \X Feeders)

Init ==
  /\ unshed = Total
  /\ shedding = 0
  /\ shed = 0
  /\ gridLock = Free
  /\ feederLock = [f \in Feeders |-> Free]
  /\ requests = {}

\* A shed request is filed; requests may arrive and be serviced in any order
FileRequest(c, f) ==
  /\ <<c, f>> \notin requests
  /\ requests' = requests \cup {<<c, f>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<unshed, shedding, shed, gridLock, feederLock>>

\* Acquire the coarse grid lock (hierarchical: grid before feeder)
AcquireGrid(c) ==
  /\ gridLock = Free
  /\ gridLock' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<unshed, shedding, shed, feederLock, requests>>

\* With the grid lock, acquire a fine feeder lock for a requested feeder
AcquireFeeder(c, f) ==
  /\ gridLock = c
  /\ <<c, f>> \in requests
  /\ feederLock[f] = Free
  /\ feederLock' = [feederLock EXCEPT ![f] = c]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<unshed, shedding, shed, gridLock, requests>>

\* Holding both locks, begin shedding one unit and release the locks and the request
BeginShed(c, f) ==
  /\ gridLock = c
  /\ feederLock[f] = c
  /\ unshed > 0
  /\ unshed' = unshed - 1
  /\ shedding' = shedding + 1
  /\ feederLock' = [feederLock EXCEPT ![f] = Free]
  /\ gridLock' = Free
  /\ requests' = { x \in requests : x[2] # f }
  /\ UNCHANGED shed

\* A shedding unit completes
CompleteShed ==
  /\ shedding > 0
  /\ shedding' = shedding - 1
  /\ shed' = shed + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<unshed, gridLock, feederLock, requests>>

\* A shed unit is restored to the pool when the emergency passes
Restore ==
  /\ shed > 0
  /\ shed' = shed - 1
  /\ unshed' = unshed + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<shedding, gridLock, feederLock, requests>>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Controllers, f \in Feeders : FileRequest(c, f)
  \/ \E c \in Controllers : AcquireGrid(c)
  \/ \E c \in Controllers, f \in Feeders : AcquireFeeder(c, f)
  \/ \E c \in Controllers, f \in Feeders : BeginShed(c, f)
  \/ CompleteShed
  \/ Restore

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Load units are conserved across the pool, in-progress shedding, and completed shed
Conservation ==
  unshed + shedding + shed = Total
====
nl: A power-grid load shedder sheds load through hierarchical locks: a controller first acquires the coarse grid lock, then a fine per-feeder lock. A shed request is filed, and because messages can be reordered, requests may arrive and be serviced in any order. With the grid lock held, a controller acquires the fine feeder lock for a requested feeder. Holding both locks, it begins shedding one unit, moving it from the shared pool into in-progress shedding, and releases both locks and the request. A shedding unit completes and becomes fully shed, and a shed unit may be restored to the pool when the emergency passes. Load units only ever move between the pool, in-progress shedding, and completed shed; none are created or destroyed. SAFETY PROPERTY: the total load units across the pool, in-progress shedding, and completed shed is always conserved and equal to the initial total.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od15m8p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Books, Instances, Authorized

VARIABLES
  coarseLock, \* holder of the coarse matching-engine lock, or "free"
  fineLock,   \* [Books -> Instances \cup {"free"}] fine per-order-book lock
  epoch,      \* current configuration epoch
  instEpoch   \* [Instances -> Nat] epoch each instance is credentialed for

vars == <<coarseLock, fineLock, epoch, instEpoch>>

Free     == "free"
MaxEpoch == 2
NoFine   == \A b \in Books : fineLock[b] = Free

TypeOK ==
  /\ coarseLock \in Instances \cup {Free}
  /\ fineLock \in [Books -> Instances \cup {Free}]
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ instEpoch \in [Instances -> 0..MaxEpoch]

Init ==
  /\ coarseLock = Free
  /\ fineLock = [b \in Books |-> Free]
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ instEpoch = [i \in Instances |-> 0]

\* An authorized, current-epoch instance takes the coarse lock
AcquireCoarse(i) ==
  /\ i \in Authorized
  /\ instEpoch[i] = epoch
  /\ coarseLock = Free
  /\ coarseLock' = i
  /\ UNCHANGED <<fineLock, epoch, instEpoch>>

\* Holding the coarse lock, an authorized current-epoch instance takes a fine lock
AcquireFine(i, b) ==
  /\ coarseLock = i
  /\ i \in Authorized
  /\ instEpoch[i] = epoch
  /\ fineLock[b] = Free
  /\ fineLock' = [fineLock EXCEPT ![b] = i]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, epoch, instEpoch>>

\* Release the fine lock on an order book
ReleaseFine(i, b) ==
  /\ fineLock[b] = i
  /\ fineLock' = [fineLock EXCEPT ![b] = Free]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, epoch, instEpoch>>

\* Release the coarse lock
ReleaseCoarse(i) ==
  /\ coarseLock = i
  /\ coarseLock' = Free
  /\ UNCHANGED <<fineLock, epoch, instEpoch>>

\* Reconfiguration bumps the epoch during a quiescent window (no fine locks held),
\* staling every instance's credential
Reconfigure ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ NoFine
  /\ coarseLock = Free
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, fineLock, instEpoch>>

\* An authorized instance renews its credential to the current epoch
Renew(i) ==
  /\ i \in Authorized
  /\ instEpoch[i] # epoch
  /\ instEpoch' = [instEpoch EXCEPT ![i] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, fineLock, epoch>>

Next ==
  \/ \E i \in Instances : AcquireCoarse(i)
  \/ \E i \in Instances, b \in Books : AcquireFine(i, b)
  \/ \E i \in Instances, b \in Books : ReleaseFine(i, b)
  \/ \E i \in Instances : ReleaseCoarse(i)
  \/ Reconfigure
  \/ \E i \in Instances : Renew(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* An order book's fine lock is held only by an authorized, current-epoch instance
NoStaleHolder ==
  \A b \in Books :
    fineLock[b] # Free => (fineLock[b] \in Authorized /\ instEpoch[fineLock[b]] = epoch)
====
nl: A stock exchange opening auction runs two authorized matching instances that share the order books, alongside a third unauthorized instance, using hierarchical locks under an epoch-numbered configuration. Only an authorized instance credentialed for the current epoch may take the coarse matching-engine lock, and only while holding it may it take a fine per-order-book lock. Locks are released fine-first then coarse. Reconfiguration bumps the epoch during a quiescent window when no fine locks are held and the coarse lock is free, staling every instance's credential; an authorized instance may renew its credential to the current epoch. SAFETY PROPERTY: an order book's fine lock is held only by an authorized instance credentialed for the current epoch.

---- MODULE W4Od18m2p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Instances, Authorized, Participants, Configs

VARIABLES
  txn,        \* the config change under two-phase commit, or "none"
  coord,      \* the instance coordinating the current transaction, or "none"
  prepared,   \* set of participants that have prepared for the current transaction
  epoch,      \* current configuration epoch
  instEpoch   \* [Instances -> Nat] epoch each instance is credentialed for

vars == <<txn, coord, prepared, epoch, instEpoch>>

NoTxn    == "none"
NoCoord  == "none"
MaxEpoch == 2

TypeOK ==
  /\ txn \in Configs \cup {NoTxn}
  /\ coord \in Instances \cup {NoCoord}
  /\ prepared \subseteq Participants
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ instEpoch \in [Instances -> 0..MaxEpoch]

Init ==
  /\ txn = NoTxn
  /\ coord = NoCoord
  /\ prepared = {}
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ instEpoch = [i \in Instances |-> 0]

\* Only an authorized instance credentialed for the current epoch may coordinate a txn
Propose(i, cf) ==
  /\ txn = NoTxn
  /\ i \in Authorized
  /\ instEpoch[i] = epoch
  /\ txn' = cf
  /\ coord' = i
  /\ prepared' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, instEpoch>>

\* A participant prepares for the current transaction
Prepare(p) ==
  /\ txn # NoTxn
  /\ p \notin prepared
  /\ prepared' = prepared \cup {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<txn, coord, epoch, instEpoch>>

\* Commit once all participants prepared, ending the transaction
Commit ==
  /\ txn # NoTxn
  /\ prepared = Participants
  /\ txn' = NoTxn
  /\ coord' = NoCoord
  /\ prepared' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, instEpoch>>

\* Abort the current transaction
Abort ==
  /\ txn # NoTxn
  /\ txn' = NoTxn
  /\ coord' = NoCoord
  /\ prepared' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, instEpoch>>

\* Reconfiguration bumps the epoch in a quiescent window, staling credentials
Reconfigure ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ txn = NoTxn
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<txn, coord, prepared, instEpoch>>

\* An authorized instance renews its credential to the current epoch
Renew(i) ==
  /\ i \in Authorized
  /\ instEpoch[i] # epoch
  /\ instEpoch' = [instEpoch EXCEPT ![i] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<txn, coord, prepared, epoch>>

Next ==
  \/ \E i \in Instances, cf \in Configs : Propose(i, cf)
  \/ \E p \in Participants : Prepare(p)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Abort
  \/ Reconfigure
  \/ \E i \in Instances : Renew(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Any in-flight transaction is coordinated by an authorized, current-epoch instance
NoStaleCoordinator ==
  txn # NoTxn => (coord \in Authorized /\ instEpoch[coord] = epoch)
====
nl: A smart-home door lock network runs two authorized controller instances that share the configuration, alongside a third unauthorized instance, applying each change via two-phase commit under an epoch-numbered configuration. Only an authorized instance credentialed for the current epoch may coordinate a transaction by proposing a config change. Each participant prepares for the current transaction, and the transaction commits once all participants have prepared, or may be aborted. Reconfiguration bumps the epoch during a quiescent window, staling every instance's credential, and an authorized instance may renew its credential to the current epoch. SAFETY PROPERTY: any in-flight transaction is coordinated only by an authorized instance credentialed for the current epoch.

---- MODULE W4Od4m4p5t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Cars, Bays

VARIABLES
  intake,   \* Seq of cars queued on the bounded intake conveyor
  rinseLog, \* Seq recording each irreversible final rinse in order
  stalled,  \* set of bays that are stalled (slow but not failed)
  parked    \* set of cars parked after processing

vars == <<intake, rinseLog, stalled, parked>>

Cap      == 2
Range(s) == { s[i] : i \in 1..Len(s) }

TypeOK ==
  /\ intake \in Seq(Cars)
  /\ rinseLog \in Seq(Cars)
  /\ stalled \subseteq Bays
  /\ parked \subseteq Cars

Init ==
  /\ intake = << >>
  /\ rinseLog = << >>
  /\ stalled = {}
  /\ parked = {}

\* A car joins the bounded intake conveyor; a full conveyor applies backpressure
Enqueue(c) ==
  /\ Len(intake) < Cap
  /\ c \notin Range(intake)
  /\ intake' = Append(intake, c)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<rinseLog, stalled, parked>>

\* A non-stalled bay applies the irreversible final rinse to the head car, once only
Rinse(b, c) ==
  /\ b \notin stalled
  /\ Len(intake) > 0
  /\ Head(intake) = c
  /\ c \notin Range(rinseLog)
  /\ rinseLog' = Append(rinseLog, c)
  /\ intake' = Tail(intake)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<stalled, parked>>

\* A car already rinsed that returns to the head is parked instead of rinsed again
Park(c) ==
  /\ Len(intake) > 0
  /\ Head(intake) = c
  /\ c \in Range(rinseLog)
  /\ intake' = Tail(intake)
  /\ parked' = parked \cup {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<rinseLog, stalled>>

\* A bay stalls (it is slow but has not failed) and stops rinsing
Stall(b) ==
  /\ b \notin stalled
  /\ stalled' = stalled \cup {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<intake, rinseLog, parked>>

\* A stalled bay catches up and resumes rinsing
Resume(b) ==
  /\ b \in stalled
  /\ stalled' = stalled \ {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<intake, rinseLog, parked>>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Cars : Enqueue(c)
  \/ \E b \in Bays, c \in Cars : Rinse(b, c)
  \/ \E c \in Cars : Park(c)
  \/ \E b \in Bays : Stall(b)
  \/ \E b \in Bays : Resume(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No car ever receives the irreversible final rinse more than once
RinseOnce ==
  \A i, j \in 1..Len(rinseLog) : (rinseLog[i] = rinseLog[j]) => (i = j)
====
nl: A car-wash conveyor line queues cars on a bounded intake conveyor with backpressure: a car joins only while the conveyor has room and it is not already queued. A non-stalled bay applies the irreversible final rinse to the car at the head of the conveyor, but only if that car has never been rinsed before, recording it in the rinse log. A car already rinsed that returns to the head is parked instead of being rinsed again. A bay may stall, being slow but not failed, and stop rinsing, and a stalled bay may catch up and resume rinsing. SAFETY PROPERTY: no car ever receives the irreversible final rinse more than once; the rinse log never records the same car twice.

---- MODULE W4Od2m3p5t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Nodes, Orders, Robots

VARIABLES
  leader,     \* the node currently elected dispatcher, or "none"
  term,       \* leadership term (advances on election)
  shipLog,    \* Seq recording each irreversible shipment in order
  adminBots   \* set of robots granted a privileged admin override

vars == <<leader, term, shipLog, adminBots>>

None    == "none"
MaxTerm == 2
Range(s) == { s[i] : i \in 1..Len(s) }

TypeOK ==
  /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {None}
  /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
  /\ shipLog \in Seq(Orders)
  /\ adminBots \subseteq Robots

Init ==
  /\ leader = None
  /\ term = 0
  /\ shipLog = << >>
  /\ adminBots = {}

\* A dispatcher is elected; a leaderless fleet can always elect
Elect(n) ==
  /\ leader = None
  /\ leader' = n
  /\ term' = IF term < MaxTerm THEN term + 1 ELSE MaxTerm
  /\ UNCHANGED <<shipLog, adminBots>>

\* The dispatcher crashes and steps down
StepDown ==
  /\ leader # None
  /\ leader' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, shipLog, adminBots>>

\* An order is irreversibly shipped, once only, either under an elected dispatcher
\* or by a robot holding a privileged admin override
Ship(o, r) ==
  /\ (leader # None \/ r \in adminBots)
  /\ o \notin Range(shipLog)
  /\ shipLog' = Append(shipLog, o)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, adminBots>>

\* The supervisor grants a privileged admin override to a robot
GrantOverride(r) ==
  /\ r \notin adminBots
  /\ adminBots' = adminBots \cup {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, shipLog>>

\* The supervisor revokes an admin override from a robot
RevokeOverride(r) ==
  /\ r \in adminBots
  /\ adminBots' = adminBots \ {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, shipLog>>

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
  \/ StepDown
  \/ \E o \in Orders, r \in Robots : Ship(o, r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : GrantOverride(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : RevokeOverride(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No order is ever shipped more than once
ShipOnce ==
  \A i, j \in 1..Len(shipLog) : (shipLog[i] = shipLog[j]) => (i = j)
====
nl: A warehouse robot fleet dispatches shipments under a dispatcher elected among nodes by leader election with failover, with a privileged admin override. A leaderless fleet can always elect a dispatcher, advancing the leadership term, and the dispatcher may crash and step down. An order is irreversibly shipped, once only, either while an elected dispatcher is present or by a robot holding a privileged admin override. The supervisor may grant a privileged admin override to a robot and may revoke it. SAFETY PROPERTY: no order is ever shipped more than once; the shipment log never records the same order twice.

---- MODULE W4Od16m8p1t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Writers

VARIABLES
  commits,     \* Seq of <<writer, basedOn>>: each committed update and the version read
  readVer,     \* [Writers -> Nat] version each writer read while preparing
  cabinetLock, \* holder of the coarse cabinet lock, or "free"
  ledgerLock   \* holder of the fine ledger-record lock, or "free"

vars == <<commits, readVer, cabinetLock, ledgerLock>>

Free       == "free"
MaxCommits == 3
Version    == Len(commits)

TypeOK ==
  /\ commits \in Seq(Writers \X (0..MaxCommits))
  /\ readVer \in [Writers -> 0..MaxCommits]
  /\ cabinetLock \in Writers \cup {Free}
  /\ ledgerLock \in Writers \cup {Free}

Init ==
  /\ commits = << >>
  /\ readVer = [w \in Writers |-> 0]
  /\ cabinetLock = Free
  /\ ledgerLock = Free

\* A writer reads the current ledger version while preparing (in any order)
Prepare(w) ==
  /\ readVer' = [readVer EXCEPT ![w] = Version]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<commits, cabinetLock, ledgerLock>>

\* Acquire the coarse cabinet lock (hierarchical: cabinet before ledger)
AcquireCabinet(w) ==
  /\ cabinetLock = Free
  /\ cabinetLock' = w
  /\ UNCHANGED <<commits, readVer, ledgerLock>>

\* Holding the cabinet lock, acquire the fine ledger-record lock
AcquireLedger(w) ==
  /\ cabinetLock = w
  /\ ledgerLock = Free
  /\ ledgerLock' = w
  /\ UNCHANGED <<commits, readVer, cabinetLock>>

\* Holding both locks, commit only if the version read is still current, then release
Commit(w) ==
  /\ cabinetLock = w
  /\ ledgerLock = w
  /\ readVer[w] = Version
  /\ Len(commits) < MaxCommits
  /\ commits' = Append(commits, <<w, readVer[w]>>)
  /\ cabinetLock' = Free
  /\ ledgerLock' = Free
  /\ UNCHANGED readVer

\* Release both locks without committing (e.g. the version moved on)
Release(w) ==
  /\ cabinetLock = w
  /\ cabinetLock' = Free
  /\ ledgerLock' = IF ledgerLock = w THEN Free ELSE ledgerLock
  /\ UNCHANGED <<commits, readVer>>

Next ==
  \/ \E w \in Writers : Prepare(w)
  \/ \E w \in Writers : AcquireCabinet(w)
  \/ \E w \in Writers : AcquireLedger(w)
  \/ \E w \in Writers : Commit(w)
  \/ \E w \in Writers : Release(w)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Each committed update was based on the version left by its immediate predecessor,
\* so no concurrent update was silently overwritten
NoLostUpdate ==
  \A k \in 1..Len(commits) : commits[k][2] = k - 1
====

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
  Writers = {w1, w2}
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl: A pharmacy prescription dispenser maintains one shared dispensing ledger updated under hierarchical locks. A writer reads the current ledger version while preparing, and because messages can be reordered, writers may prepare in any order. A writer first acquires the coarse cabinet lock, then the fine ledger-record lock. Holding both locks, it commits its update only if the version it read is still the current version, appending its update and recording the version it was based on, then releasing both locks; otherwise it releases the locks without committing because the version has moved on. SAFETY PROPERTY: each committed update was based on the version left by its immediate predecessor, so no update is ever lost.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od18m1p4t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Nodes, Doors

VARIABLES
  token,    \* the node currently holding the ring token
  open,     \* set of doors currently unlocked
  requests, \* set of doors with a pending unlock request
  admits    \* [Nodes -> Nat] count of unlocks each node has performed

vars == <<token, open, requests, admits>>

Cap       == 2
MaxAdmit  == 3
NodeCount == 3
NextNode(n) == IF n = NodeCount - 1 THEN 0 ELSE n + 1

TypeOK ==
  /\ token \in Nodes
  /\ open \subseteq Doors
  /\ requests \subseteq Doors
  /\ admits \in [Nodes -> 0..MaxAdmit]

Init ==
  /\ token = 0
  /\ open = {}
  /\ requests = {}
  /\ admits = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]

\* A door unlock is requested
Request(d) ==
  /\ d \notin requests
  /\ requests' = requests \cup {d}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, open, admits>>

\* Only the token-holder may unlock a door, and only while fewer than Cap are open
Unlock(d) ==
  /\ d \in requests
  /\ d \notin open
  /\ Cardinality(open) < Cap
  /\ admits[token] < MaxAdmit
  /\ open' = open \cup {d}
  /\ requests' = requests \ {d}
  /\ admits' = [admits EXCEPT ![token] = @ + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED token

\* A door is relocked, freeing capacity
Relock(d) ==
  /\ d \in open
  /\ open' = open \ {d}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, requests, admits>>

\* The token is passed to the next node; a slow node simply passes it on
PassToken ==
  /\ token' = NextNode(token)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<open, requests, admits>>

Next ==
  \/ \E d \in Doors : Request(d)
  \/ \E d \in Doors : Unlock(d)
  \/ \E d \in Doors : Relock(d)
  \/ PassToken

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The number of simultaneously unlocked doors never exceeds the capacity
BoundedOpen ==
  Cardinality(open) <= Cap
====
nl: A smart-home door lock network coordinates its controller nodes with a token ring, allowing at most a fixed capacity of doors to be unlocked at once. A door unlock is requested. Only the current token-holder may unlock a door, and only while fewer than the capacity of doors are currently open, recording the unlock against that node. A door is relocked, freeing capacity. The token is passed to the next node in the ring, and a node that is slow but has not failed simply passes the token on. Because an unlock is only permitted while fewer than the capacity of doors are open, the open count never exceeds the capacity. SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of simultaneously unlocked doors never exceeds the capacity.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od15m3p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Nodes, Listings, Instances

VARIABLES
  leader,   \* the node currently elected sequencer, or "none"
  term,     \* leadership term (advances on election)
  grants,   \* set of <<listing, instance>> confirmed listing-slot allocations
  pending   \* set of <<listing, instance>> allocation requests

vars == <<leader, term, grants, pending>>

None    == "none"
MaxTerm == 2
ListOf(g) == g[1]
InstOf(g) == g[2]
ListTaken(l) == \E g \in grants : ListOf(g) = l

TypeOK ==
  /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {None}
  /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
  /\ grants \subseteq (Listings \X Instances)
  /\ pending \subseteq (Listings \X Instances)

Init ==
  /\ leader = None
  /\ term = 0
  /\ grants = {}
  /\ pending = {}

\* A sequencer is elected; a leaderless exchange can always elect
Elect(n) ==
  /\ leader = None
  /\ leader' = n
  /\ term' = IF term < MaxTerm THEN term + 1 ELSE MaxTerm
  /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, pending>>

\* The sequencer crashes and steps down
StepDown ==
  /\ leader # None
  /\ leader' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, grants, pending>>

\* An instance requests a listing slot
Request(l, i) ==
  /\ <<l, i>> \notin pending
  /\ <<l, i>> \notin grants
  /\ pending' = pending \cup {<<l, i>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, grants>>

\* Only the current sequencer may confirm an allocation for an untaken listing
Allocate(l, i) ==
  /\ leader # None
  /\ <<l, i>> \in pending
  /\ ~ListTaken(l)
  /\ grants' = grants \cup {<<l, i>>}
  /\ pending' = pending \ {<<l, i>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term>>

\* An instance releases its listing slot
Release(l, i) ==
  /\ <<l, i>> \in grants
  /\ grants' = grants \ {<<l, i>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, pending>>

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
  \/ StepDown
  \/ \E l \in Listings, i \in Instances : Request(l, i)
  \/ \E l \in Listings, i \in Instances : Allocate(l, i)
  \/ \E l \in Listings, i \in Instances : Release(l, i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No listing slot is ever allocated to two different instances at once
NoDoubleAlloc ==
  \A x, y \in grants : (ListOf(x) = ListOf(y)) => (InstOf(x) = InstOf(y))
====

MachOf(g) == g[2]
Taken(s)  == \E g \in grants : SlotOf(g) = s

  /\ UNCHANGED <<proposed, ballots, adminGrant>>

---- MODULE W4Od5m8p4t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Lobbies, Matchmakers

VARIABLES
  regionLock,  \* holder of the coarse region lock, or "free"
  lobbyLock,   \* [Lobbies -> Matchmakers \cup {"free"}] fine per-lobby lock
  occupancy,   \* [Lobbies -> Nat] players currently seated in each lobby
  stalled      \* set of matchmakers that are slow (stalled but not failed)

vars == <<regionLock, lobbyLock, occupancy, stalled>>

Free   == "free"
Cap    == 2

TypeOK ==
  /\ regionLock \in Matchmakers \cup {Free}
  /\ lobbyLock \in [Lobbies -> Matchmakers \cup {Free}]
  /\ occupancy \in [Lobbies -> 0..Cap]
  /\ stalled \subseteq Matchmakers

Init ==
  /\ regionLock = Free
  /\ lobbyLock = [l \in Lobbies |-> Free]
  /\ occupancy = [l \in Lobbies |-> 0]
  /\ stalled = {}

\* A non-stalled matchmaker takes the coarse region lock (region before lobby)
AcquireRegion(mm) ==
  /\ mm \notin stalled
  /\ regionLock = Free
  /\ regionLock' = mm
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lobbyLock, occupancy, stalled>>

\* Holding the region lock, take a fine lobby lock
AcquireLobby(mm, l) ==
  /\ regionLock = mm
  /\ lobbyLock[l] = Free
  /\ lobbyLock' = [lobbyLock EXCEPT ![l] = mm]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<regionLock, occupancy, stalled>>

\* Holding both locks, seat one player while the lobby is below capacity
Seat(mm, l) ==
  /\ regionLock = mm
  /\ lobbyLock[l] = mm
  /\ occupancy[l] < Cap
  /\ occupancy' = [occupancy EXCEPT ![l] = @ + 1]
  /\ lobbyLock' = [lobbyLock EXCEPT ![l] = Free]
  /\ regionLock' = Free
  /\ UNCHANGED stalled

\* A player leaves a lobby, freeing a seat
Leave(l) ==
  /\ occupancy[l] > 0
  /\ occupancy' = [occupancy EXCEPT ![l] = @ - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<regionLock, lobbyLock, stalled>>

\* A matchmaker stalls (slow but not failed), releasing any locks it held
Stall(mm) ==
  /\ mm \notin stalled
  /\ stalled' = stalled \cup {mm}
  /\ regionLock' = IF regionLock = mm THEN Free ELSE regionLock
  /\ lobbyLock' = [l \in Lobbies |-> IF lobbyLock[l] = mm THEN Free ELSE lobbyLock[l]]
  /\ UNCHANGED occupancy

\* A stalled matchmaker catches up and resumes
Resume(mm) ==
  /\ mm \in stalled
  /\ stalled' = stalled \ {mm}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<regionLock, lobbyLock, occupancy>>

Next ==
  \/ \E mm \in Matchmakers : AcquireRegion(mm)
  \/ \E mm \in Matchmakers, l \in Lobbies : AcquireLobby(mm, l)
  \/ \E mm \in Matchmakers, l \in Lobbies : Seat(mm, l)
  \/ \E l \in Lobbies : Leave(l)
  \/ \E mm \in Matchmakers : Stall(mm)
  \/ \E mm \in Matchmakers : Resume(mm)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lobby ever seats more than its capacity of players
BoundedCapacity ==
  \A l \in Lobbies : occupancy[l] <= Cap
====
nl: A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker seats players into lobbies under hierarchical locks: a matchmaker first acquires the coarse region lock, then a fine per-lobby lock. Holding both locks, it seats one player only while that lobby is below its capacity, then releases both locks. A player may leave a lobby, freeing a seat. A matchmaker may stall, being slow but not failed, releasing any locks it held, and a stalled matchmaker may catch up and resume. Because a seat is only added while the lobby is below capacity, no lobby ever overflows. SAFETY PROPERTY: no lobby ever seats more than its capacity of players.

CONSTANTS Chutes, Bags

  reg,      \* [Chutes -> Bags \cup {"free"}] compare-and-swap assignment register
  routedTo, \* [Bags -> Chutes \cup {"none"}] chute a bag is assigned to
  pending,  \* set of <<chute, bag>> assignment requests (arrive reordered)
  cleared   \* set of <<chute, bag>> assignments that have cleared the chute

vars == <<reg, routedTo, pending, cleared>>

Free == "free"
NoC  == "none"

TypeOK ==
  /\ reg \in [Chutes -> Bags \cup {Free}]
  /\ routedTo \in [Bags -> Chutes \cup {NoC}]
  /\ pending \subseteq (Chutes \X Bags)
  /\ cleared \subseteq (Chutes \X Bags)

Init ==
  /\ reg = [ch \in Chutes |-> Free]
  /\ routedTo = [b \in Bags |-> NoC]
  /\ pending = {}
  /\ cleared = {}

\* An assignment request is submitted; requests may arrive in any order
Request(ch, b) ==
  /\ <<ch, b>> \notin pending
  /\ pending' = pending \cup {<<ch, b>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, routedTo, cleared>>

\* Compare-and-swap: assign a bag to a chute only by swapping the register from free
Assign(ch, b) ==
  /\ <<ch, b>> \in pending
  /\ reg[ch] = Free
  /\ routedTo[b] = NoC
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![ch] = b]
  /\ routedTo' = [routedTo EXCEPT ![b] = ch]
  /\ pending' = pending \ {<<ch, b>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED cleared

\* A bag clears its chute, swapping the register back to free
Clear(ch, b) ==
  /\ reg[ch] = b
  /\ routedTo[b] = ch
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![ch] = Free]
  /\ routedTo' = [routedTo EXCEPT ![b] = NoC]
  /\ cleared' = cleared \cup {<<ch, b>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED pending

\* A reordered or superseded request is dropped
Cancel(ch, b) ==
  /\ <<ch, b>> \in pending
  /\ pending' = pending \ {<<ch, b>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, routedTo, cleared>>

Next ==
  \/ \E ch \in Chutes, b \in Bags : Request(ch, b)
  \/ \E ch \in Chutes, b \in Bags : Assign(ch, b)
  \/ \E ch \in Chutes, b \in Bags : Clear(ch, b)
  \/ \E ch \in Chutes, b \in Bags : Cancel(ch, b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No chute is ever assigned to two different bags at once (the register is single-valued)
NoDoubleAlloc ==
  \A b1, b2 \in Bags :
    (routedTo[b1] # NoC /\ routedTo[b1] = routedTo[b2]) => b1 = b2

An assignment request is submitted, and because messages can be reordered, requests may arrive in any order. A bag is assigned to a chute only by a compare-and-swap that succeeds when the chute's register is free, swapping it from free to that bag; a bag holds at most one chute. A bag clears its chute by swapping the register back to free. A reordered or superseded request may be dropped. SAFETY PROPERTY: no chute is ever assigned to two different bags at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od4m6p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Bays, Cars

VARIABLES
  leases,   \* set of <<bay, car, leaseEnd>> active bay leases
  clock,    \* current logical clock
  washing,  \* set of <<bay, car>> cars currently being washed under a lease
  finished  \* set of <<bay, car>> completed washes

vars == <<leases, clock, washing, finished>>

MaxTime == 3
LeaseK  == 2
BayOf(g) == g[1]
CarOf(g) == g[2]
EndOf(g) == g[3]
BayLeased(b) == \E g \in leases : BayOf(g) = b

TypeOK ==
  /\ leases \subseteq (Bays \X Cars \X (0..MaxTime))
  /\ clock \in 0..MaxTime
  /\ washing \subseteq (Bays \X Cars)
  /\ finished \subseteq (Bays \X Cars)

Init ==
  /\ leases = {}
  /\ clock = 0
  /\ washing = {}
  /\ finished = {}

\* A car leases a currently-unleased bay until LeaseK ticks from now
Acquire(b, c) ==
  /\ ~BayLeased(b)
  /\ clock + LeaseK <= MaxTime
  /\ leases' = leases \cup {<<b, c, clock + LeaseK>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, washing, finished>>

\* The lease-holder begins washing while its lease is still valid
BeginWash(b, c, e) ==
  /\ <<b, c, e>> \in leases
  /\ e > clock
  /\ <<b, c>> \notin washing
  /\ washing' = washing \cup {<<b, c>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leases, clock, finished>>

\* A wash finishes and the lease is released
Finish(b, c, e) ==
  /\ <<b, c, e>> \in leases
  /\ <<b, c>> \in washing
  /\ leases' = leases \ {<<b, c, e>>}
  /\ washing' = washing \ {<<b, c>>}
  /\ finished' = finished \cup {<<b, c>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED clock

\* An expired lease is reclaimed, freeing the bay (the slow holder simply lost its turn)
Expire(b, c, e) ==
  /\ <<b, c, e>> \in leases
  /\ e <= clock
  /\ <<b, c>> \notin washing
  /\ leases' = leases \ {<<b, c, e>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, washing, finished>>

\* Time advances, but never past the expiry of a lease whose wash is in progress
Tick ==
  /\ clock < MaxTime
  /\ \A g \in leases : <<BayOf(g), CarOf(g)>> \notin washing \/ EndOf(g) > clock + 1
  /\ clock' = clock + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leases, washing, finished>>

\* When the yard is idle, the clock is reset for the next cycle of leases
Reset ==
  /\ clock > 0
  /\ leases = {}
  /\ washing = {}
  /\ clock' = 0
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leases, washing, finished>>

Next ==
  \/ \E b \in Bays, c \in Cars : Acquire(b, c)
  \/ \E b \in Bays, c \in Cars, e \in 0..MaxTime : BeginWash(b, c, e)
  \/ \E b \in Bays, c \in Cars, e \in 0..MaxTime : Finish(b, c, e)
  \/ \E b \in Bays, c \in Cars, e \in 0..MaxTime : Expire(b, c, e)
  \/ Tick
  \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No bay is ever leased to two different cars at the same time
NoDoubleAlloc ==
  \A x, y \in leases : (BayOf(x) = BayOf(y)) => (CarOf(x) = CarOf(y))
====
nl: A car-wash conveyor line assigns wash bays to cars using lease-based ownership with expiry against a logical clock. A car leases a currently-unleased bay, holding it until a fixed number of ticks in the future. The lease-holder begins washing while its lease is still valid, and when the wash finishes the lease is released. An expired lease is reclaimed, freeing the bay; a holder that was merely slow has simply lost its turn without failing. Time advances one tick at a time, but never past the expiry of a lease whose wash is still in progress. Because a bay can only be leased while it is unleased, it is never held by two cars at once. SAFETY PROPERTY: no bay is ever leased to two different cars at the same time.

EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Zones, Drones, Voters

VARIABLES
  lock,      \* [Zones -> Drones \cup {"free"}] exclusive holder of each zone
  inZone,    \* [Drones -> Zones \cup {"none"}] zone a drone is currently surveying
  votes,     \* set of <<zone, drone, voter>> approvals
  capacity   \* max zones that may be locked at once (changes at runtime)

vars == <<lock, inZone, votes, capacity>>

Free   == "free"
NoZ    == "none"
Quorum == 2
MaxCap == 2
ApprovalsFor(z, d) == { v \in Voters : <<z, d, v>> \in votes }
LockedCount == Cardinality({ z \in Zones : lock[z] # Free })

TypeOK ==
  /\ lock \in [Zones -> Drones \cup {Free}]
  /\ inZone \in [Drones -> Zones \cup {NoZ}]
  /\ votes \subseteq (Zones \X Drones \X Voters)
  /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
  /\ lock = [z \in Zones |-> Free]
  /\ inZone = [d \in Drones |-> NoZ]
  /\ votes = {}
  /\ capacity = 2

\* A voter approves a drone taking a zone
Approve(z, d, v) ==
  /\ <<z, d, v>> \notin votes
  /\ votes' = votes \cup {<<z, d, v>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, inZone, capacity>>

\* Enter a free zone once a quorum approves and the capacity budget allows
Enter(z, d) ==
  /\ lock[z] = Free
  /\ inZone[d] = NoZ
  /\ Cardinality(ApprovalsFor(z, d)) >= Quorum
  /\ LockedCount < capacity
  /\ lock' = [lock EXCEPT ![z] = d]
  /\ inZone' = [inZone EXCEPT ![d] = z]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, capacity>>

\* A drone leaves the zone it holds
Leave(z, d) ==
  /\ lock[z] = d
  /\ inZone[d] = z
  /\ lock' = [lock EXCEPT ![z] = Free]
  /\ inZone' = [inZone EXCEPT ![d] = NoZ]
  /\ votes' = { x \in votes : ~(x[1] = z /\ x[2] = d) }
  /\ UNCHANGED capacity

\* The survey capacity budget is changed at runtime
Rescale(k) ==
  /\ k \in 0..MaxCap
  /\ k # capacity
  /\ capacity' = k
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, inZone, votes>>

Next ==
  \/ \E z \in Zones, d \in Drones, v \in Voters : Approve(z, d, v)
  \/ \E z \in Zones, d \in Drones : Enter(z, d)
  \/ \E z \in Zones, d \in Drones : Leave(z, d)
  \/ \E k \in 0..MaxCap : Rescale(k)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A drone surveys a zone only while it exclusively holds that zone's lock
Mutex ==
  \A d \in Drones : inZone[d] # NoZ => lock[inZone[d]] = d
====
nl: A wildfire drone surveillance swarm grants exclusive survey rights over zones, approved by quorum voting among voters, under a survey capacity budget that changes at runtime. A voter approves a drone taking a zone. A drone enters a free zone once a quorum of voters has approved and the number of zones currently locked is below the capacity budget, taking exclusive hold of that zone's lock. A drone leaves the zone it holds, discarding the approvals for that pairing. The survey capacity budget is changed at runtime. SAFETY PROPERTY: a drone surveys a zone only while it exclusively holds that zone's lock, so no two drones ever share a zone.

---- MODULE W4Od9m3p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Nodes, Commands

VARIABLES
  leader,     \* the node currently elected controller, or "none"
  term,       \* leadership term (advances on election)
  executing,  \* the node currently executing a command, or "none"
  pending,    \* set of shed commands awaiting execution (arrive reordered)
  applied     \* set of commands that have been applied

vars == <<leader, term, executing, pending, applied>>

None    == "none"
MaxTerm == 2

TypeOK ==
  /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {None}
  /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
  /\ executing \in Nodes \cup {None}
  /\ pending \subseteq Commands
  /\ applied \subseteq Commands

Init ==
  /\ leader = None
  /\ term = 0
  /\ executing = None
  /\ pending = {}
  /\ applied = {}

\* A controller is elected during a quiescent window (no one executing)
Elect(n) ==
  /\ leader = None
  /\ executing = None
  /\ leader' = n
  /\ term' = IF term < MaxTerm THEN term + 1 ELSE MaxTerm
  /\ UNCHANGED <<executing, pending, applied>>

\* The controller steps down during a quiescent window
StepDown ==
  /\ leader # None
  /\ executing = None
  /\ leader' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, executing, pending, applied>>

\* A shed command is submitted; commands may arrive in any order
Submit(c) ==
  /\ c \notin pending
  /\ c \notin applied
  /\ pending' = pending \cup {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, executing, applied>>

\* Only the current controller may begin executing a pending command
StartExec(n, c) ==
  /\ n = leader
  /\ executing = None
  /\ c \in pending
  /\ executing' = n
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, pending, applied>>

\* The executing controller finishes applying the command
FinishExec(c) ==
  /\ executing # None
  /\ c \in pending
  /\ executing' = None
  /\ pending' = pending \ {c}
  /\ applied' = applied \cup {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term>>

  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
  \/ StepDown
  \/ \E c \in Commands : Submit(c)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes, c \in Commands : StartExec(n, c)
  \/ \E c \in Commands : FinishExec(c)

\* Any command execution in progress is being run by the current controller
NoStaleExecutor ==
  executing # None => executing = leader
====

A controller is elected during a quiescent window when no command is executing, and it steps down only while quiescent. Shed commands are submitted and, because messages can be reordered, may arrive in any order. Only the current controller may begin executing a pending command, and the executing controller later finishes applying it. Because leadership only changes while no command is executing, an execution in progress is always run by the current controller. SAFETY PROPERTY: any command execution in progress is being run by the current controller, never by a former or unauthorized node.

CONSTANTS Cars, Bays

VARIABLES
  pool,     \* cars waiting in the arrival pool
  belt,     \* Seq of cars on the bounded intake belt
  inWash,   \* number of cars currently being washed
  done,     \* cars that have completed the wash
  stalled   \* set of bays that are slow (stalled but not failed)

vars == <<pool, belt, inWash, done, stalled>>

Cap   == 2
Total == 3

TypeOK ==
  /\ pool \in 0..Total
  /\ belt \in Seq(Cars)
  /\ inWash \in 0..Total
  /\ done \in 0..Total
  /\ stalled \subseteq Bays

Init ==
  /\ pool = Total
  /\ belt = << >>
  /\ inWash = 0
  /\ done = 0
  /\ stalled = {}

\* A car moves from the arrival pool onto the bounded belt; a full belt backpressures
Enqueue(c) ==
  /\ pool > 0
  /\ Len(belt) < Cap
  /\ pool' = pool - 1
  /\ belt' = Append(belt, c)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<inWash, done, stalled>>

\* A non-stalled bay pulls the car at the head of the belt into the wash
Claim(b, c) ==
  /\ b \notin stalled
  /\ Len(belt) > 0
  /\ Head(belt) = c
  /\ belt' = Tail(belt)
  /\ inWash' = inWash + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, done, stalled>>

\* A car completes the wash
Complete ==
  /\ inWash > 0
  /\ inWash' = inWash - 1
  /\ done' = done + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, belt, stalled>>

\* A finished car leaves and a fresh arrival re-enters the pool
Recycle ==
  /\ done > 0
  /\ done' = done - 1
  /\ pool' = pool + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<belt, inWash, stalled>>

\* A bay stalls (slow but not failed) and stops pulling cars
Stall(b) ==
  /\ b \notin stalled
  /\ stalled' = stalled \cup {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, belt, inWash, done>>

\* A stalled bay catches up and resumes
Resume(b) ==
  /\ b \in stalled
  /\ stalled' = stalled \ {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, belt, inWash, done>>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Cars : Enqueue(c)
  \/ \E b \in Bays, c \in Cars : Claim(b, c)
  \/ Complete
  \/ Recycle
  \/ \E b \in Bays : Stall(b)
  \/ \E b \in Bays : Resume(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The total number of cars is conserved across all stages of the wash
Conservation ==
  pool + Len(belt) + inWash + done = Total
====
nl: A car-wash conveyor line moves cars from an arrival pool across a bounded intake belt with backpressure: a car joins the belt only while it has room. A non-stalled bay pulls the car at the head of the belt into the wash, and a car later completes the wash. A finished car leaves and a fresh arrival re-enters the pool. A bay may stall, being slow but not failed, and stop pulling cars, and a stalled bay may catch up and resume. Cars only ever move between the arrival pool, the intake belt, the wash, and the completed count; none are created or destroyed. SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of cars across the arrival pool, the intake belt, the wash, and the completed count is always conserved and equal to the initial total.

---- MODULE W4Od2m0p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Slots, Robots

VARIABLES
  grants,   \* set of <<slot, robot>> confirmed allocations
  version,  \* [Slots -> Nat] optimistic version counter per slot
  reading,  \* set of robots holding a live optimistic read
  rdSlot,   \* [Robots -> Slots] slot each reading robot read
  rdVer     \* [Robots -> Nat] version each reading robot observed

vars == <<grants, version, reading, rdSlot, rdVer>>

MaxV == 3
SlotOf(g) == g[1]
RobOf(g)  == g[2]
Taken(s)  == \E g \in grants : SlotOf(g) = s

TypeOK ==
  /\ grants \subseteq (Slots \X Robots)
  /\ version \in [Slots -> 0..MaxV]
  /\ reading \subseteq Robots
  /\ rdSlot \in [Robots -> Slots]
  /\ rdVer \in [Robots -> 0..MaxV]

Init ==
  /\ grants = {}
  /\ version = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
  /\ reading = {}
  /\ rdSlot = [r \in Robots |-> CHOOSE s \in Slots : TRUE]
  /\ rdVer = [r \in Robots |-> 0]

\* A robot optimistically reads a slot's current version
Read(r, s) ==
  /\ r \notin reading
  /\ reading' = reading \cup {r}
  /\ rdSlot' = [rdSlot EXCEPT ![r] = s]
  /\ rdVer' = [rdVer EXCEPT ![r] = version[s]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, version>>

\* Commit succeeds only if the version is unchanged since the read and the slot is free
TryCommit(r) ==
  /\ r \in reading
  /\ version[rdSlot[r]] = rdVer[r]
  /\ version[rdSlot[r]] < MaxV
  /\ ~Taken(rdSlot[r])
  /\ grants' = grants \cup {<<rdSlot[r], r>>}
  /\ version' = [version EXCEPT ![rdSlot[r]] = @ + 1]
  /\ reading' = reading \ {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<rdSlot, rdVer>>

\* If the version moved on since the read, the robot retries by re-reading later
Retry(r) ==
  /\ r \in reading
  /\ version[rdSlot[r]] # rdVer[r]
  /\ reading' = reading \ {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, version, rdSlot, rdVer>>

\* A slow robot abandons its read and will re-read later
Abandon(r) ==
  /\ r \in reading
  /\ reading' = reading \ {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, version, rdSlot, rdVer>>

\* A robot releases its allocation, freeing the slot
Release(s, r) ==
  /\ <<s, r>> \in grants
  /\ grants' = grants \ {<<s, r>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, reading, rdSlot, rdVer>>

Next ==
  \/ \E r \in Robots, s \in Slots : Read(r, s)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : TryCommit(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : Retry(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : Abandon(r)
  \/ \E s \in Slots, r \in Robots : Release(s, r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No slot is ever allocated to two different robots at the same time
NoDoubleAlloc ==
  \A x, y \in grants : (SlotOf(x) = SlotOf(y)) => (RobOf(x) = RobOf(y))
====
nl: A warehouse robot fleet allocates staging slots using optimistic locking with retry. A robot optimistically reads a slot's current version. It then tries to commit an allocation, which succeeds only if the slot's version is unchanged since the read and the slot is still free, bumping the version on success. If the version has moved on since the read, the robot retries by re-reading; a robot that is slow but has not failed simply retries later. A robot releases its allocation, freeing the slot. SAFETY PROPERTY: no slot is ever allocated to two different robots at the same time.
